name: webapp-docs-kit
description: Visual checks, user manuals (PDF/DOCX) and video walkthroughs (MP4) for web apps, captured from the real app with Playwright.

interface.longDescription: Three skills for web apps: /visual-check screenshots the screens a change touches and reports JS errors, failed requests and blank pages; /user-manual writes one PDF/DOCX manual per role with real screenshots; /video-tutorial renders one MP4 walkthrough per role with zoom, a red highlight box, a cursor and captions.
